name: Essential Upsell & Cross Sell
summary: Shopify upsell and cross-sell app with frequently-bought-together blocks, product-page and cart-drawer offers, one-click post-purchase upsells, bundles, add-ons and automatic discounts, with plans tiered by the extra revenue the app attributes to its offers.
best_for: Shopify stores that want product-page, cart and post-purchase upsells, frequently-bought-together blocks and add-ons in one app, with a monthly bill that cannot go above $39.99 however much the offers sell
skip_if: you want cart-drawer upsells for free, since the listing puts cart-page offers on the $19.99 Essential plan; you will not grant an app access to customer and order data; or you only want post-purchase offers and would rather pay a share of upsell revenue than a fixed plan
honest_knock:
The plans are metered on revenue the app says it generated, and the free plan's $100 a month is a small allowance. A store whose upsells work moves up the ladder because they work: $500 on Starter, $1,000 on Essential, and only Professional at $39.99 a month has no limit. Neither the listing nor the vendor's page explains how that revenue is attributed to the app or what happens when a store passes its limit, so ask support before you rely on the free plan in a busy month. The ceiling is the reassuring part: the bill cannot go above $39.99 a month, however much the offers sell.

The two pricing pages do not agree on the cart. On the Shopify listing, cart-page offers start on Essential at $19.99; the vendor's own page lists them on Starter at $9.99 too. The cart drawer is where many stores want an upsell, so confirm in the app which plan unlocks it before you pick Starter.

The free plan is a real plan, but it does not look like one at install. A US merchant wrote in February 2026 that the app advertised a free plan and then pushed a free trial; the vendor replied that the free plan has a revenue limit and needs a Shopify approval step. Read the approval screen rather than closing it.

The app asks for a lot of data. The listing says it needs to view and edit customers, products, orders, discounts and the online store. Two US merchants dropped it to one star in 2024 and 2025 over permissions that covered customers' personal details and recent orders; the vendor answered that the access is for the performance analytics merchants asked for. If you keep a tight data policy, read the permission screen before you approve it.

The rest of the criticism is about fit with a theme or a store setup. A French merchant uninstalled in November 2025 because widgets did not show on pages whose product handle had been translated; the vendor replied in February 2026 that product targeting now uses the product ID instead of the handle. A UK merchant wrote in September 2025 that it did not work with their cart drawer. The positive reviews mostly praise support that fixed this kind of clash, such as a merchant in Romania whose cart offers broke the item list on a Halo theme and were fixed within a day in September 2026. We have not installed the app.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Starter · per month for up to $500 of revenue generated by the app
pricing.notes: (read 2026-10-02 on apps.shopify.com/essential-post-purchase-upsell and on essential-apps.com/upsell) Four plans, priced not on orders or views but on the extra revenue the app generates in a month. Free covers up to $100 of generated revenue with product-page and post-purchase offers, analytics and translations. Starter is $9.99 a month for up to $500. Essential is $19.99 a month for up to $1,000 and, on the Shopify listing, is the first plan with cart-page offers. Professional is $39.99 a month with no revenue limit. Each paid plan has a 14-day free trial. The vendor's own page names the top plan Plus, lists cart offers on Starter as well, and adds a 30-day money-back guarantee that the listing does not mention; where the two differ, the listing is the page you are billed from. Neither page explains how generated revenue is counted or what happens when a store passes its limit. All charges are in USD, billed through Shopify every 30 days. Developer Essential Bundles & Upsells, with an address in Vilnius, Lithuania; the listing gives a launch date of 10 June 2024 and shows 2,405 reviews, nine of them at three stars or lower.

compare_with.name: AfterSell
compare_with.why: AfterSell is the closest app in our own dossiers, and the two price on different things. On our reading of 27 September 2026, AfterSell charged by monthly order volume: its Post-Purchase plan started at $34.99 a month for 200 orders and its Pre-Purchase and Complete plans at $59.99 and $79.99, with each rising as orders grow. Essential Upsell & Cross Sell prices on the extra revenue it generates instead: free up to $100, then $9.99, $19.99 and an unlimited plan at $39.99 that covers product-page, cart and post-purchase offers together. A store with many orders and modest upsell revenue will usually pay less with Essential; AfterSell's own pages are worth reading if you want its checkout-focused offers.
